deal.dialogue: Ahead there's a beast waiting for you. I can make it a hearth instead, for a modest donation of blood. Don't ask what's feeding the fire.
I've seen the road ahead, and frankly it was too comfortable. Let me move some furniture. You'll thank me. Eventually.
I've seen the road ahead, and frankly it was too comfortable. Let me move some furniture. You'll thank me. Eventually.
A formality. Sign here and the road gets easy. Think of me as insurance. You'll never need the claim.
A coin for your trouble. It's warm. It remembers where it was minted, and it will want to go home through your ribs.
